_doc: State matrix for tools/dev/sweep.ps1 (qa/round5/METHOD.md, layer 2). Run: powershell -File tools\dev\sweep.ps1 -Exe <exe> -Out <dir> [-Filter <regex>] [-MaxPriority 1].

A scenario: name, screen, description, priority (1 = every run, 2 = full matrix, 3 = needs newer tools), library (folder or list), files (opened at start), settings (settings.json values), ui (ui.json values), seed (data files), onboarding (keep first run), size (min | WxH | max | fullscreen, applied before the steps), postSize (applied to the target window after the steps), settleMs, waitMs, hitmap (also sweep WM_NCHITTEST), target (window to capture: main | owned | {title}), requires ([scale], [cmd]), vary ({dimension: [values]}: the cross product of only these, values defined in dimensions), steps.

A step does one or more of: cmd (tools/dev/command.ps1 text; when command.ps1 exists the step runs only this, otherwise its other fields are the fallback), keys ("Ctrl+Shift+P" or a list; System.Windows.Forms.Keys names), type (text), move | click | double | right | wheel (+delta) with a selector, mods ([ctrl, shift]), window (switch the target: main | owned | {title}), size, wait (ms), capture (extra capture label), after (ms after the step, default 250).

A selector: "x,y" in DIPs, or {type (regex on the short widget type), id, text (v2 dumps), popup (true/false), parent, nth (negative from the end)} plus the point: center, dx/dy (DIPs, negative from the right/bottom), fx/fy (fractions), card k (ItemGrid card; cardStyle square|video), row k (ItemGrid list row; rowTop).
Posted Ctrl+letter keys also reach TranslateMessage, so a focused text box receives the letter: such steps add Backspace, and the search box is clicked rather than opened with Ctrl+K.
Never press: Ctrl+O, Ctrl+F (native file and folder pickers), Обзор/Browse buttons, Settings > General > file associations (#file-associations).
